strings.파이프라인 핸들러는 completeBuffer()로 버퍼 완료를 알려야: The pipeline handler must signal buffer completion with completeBuffer(), which must be called from the {{1}} thread. Completing the last buffer does not automatically complete the request, so request completion must be explicitly signalled using completeRequest().
strings.파이프라인 핸들러는 completeRequest()가 반환된 뒤 해당 요: The pipeline handler must not access a request after completeRequest() returns. The request may be deleted immediately after return, so this access restriction must be respected.
strings.파이프라인 핸들러는 completeRequest()를 {{1}} 스레드에: The pipeline handler must call completeRequest() from the {{1}} thread. Completed requests may be passed to this function out of order, but the contract returns them to the application in submission order.
strings.파이프라인 핸들러는 stop()으로 파이프라인이 중지될 때 대기 중인 모: The pipeline handler must send a completion signal using the completeRequest() Function to ensure that all pending requests are completed when the pipeline is stopped with stop().
strings.파이프라인 핸들러는 {{1}}가 반환한 뒤 해당 요청에 접근하면 안 됩니: The pipeline handler must not access the request after {{1}} returns. The same rule applies to {{3}}, which cancels and completes the request.
strings.파이프라인과 알고리즘은 어떤 입력과 결과를 주고받습니까?: Which inputs and results pass between the pipeline and algorithms?
strings.파이프라인은 요청을 대기 큐에 넣어 준비시킨 뒤 맨 앞부터 장치로 보냅니: The pipeline puts requests into a waiting queue for preparation, then dispatches from the front. Iteration stops if the front request is unprepared or device queue size equals the limit. {{1}} must program the device to apply request parameters to the frames captured in its buffers.
strings.파이프라인의 {{1}}와 {{3}}는 {{5}} 스레드에서 호출하는 계약: The pipeline's {{1}} and {{3}} must be called from the {{5}} thread. Requests still require explicit completion after all buffers finish; after {{7}} returns, the handler must not access the request.

strings.파이프라인이 0을 반환해도 {{1}}이 비어 있으면 {{3}}는 오류를: Even if the pipeline returns 0, {{3}} reports an error when {{1}} is empty. The {{5}} branch in the source is where to investigate stream binding in the device implementation. It transitions to {{7}} only after all bindings pass.

strings.호출자가 {{1}} 함수에서 성공 코드를 반환받으면, 시스템 내 모든 장: If the caller receives a success code from the {{1}} Function, all devices within the system are enumerated, allowing the camera to be listed and interacted with.
strings.호출자가 장치 한도를 초과하여 제출한 나머지 요청은 내부 대기 큐에 보관: Requests submitted by the caller that exceed the device limit are held in an internal waiting queue until they can be processed later.
strings.호출자는 {{1}} 가 반환하는 요청의 소유권을 가지며, 완료 처리기에서: The caller owns the request returned by {{1}} and must either delete it in completion handling or reset its state using {{3}} before reusing it.
strings.호출자는 {{1}} 와 get() 을 호출하기 전에 카메라 매니저가 실행: The caller must check whether the camera manager is running before calling {{1}} and get().
strings.호출자는 {{1}}를 호출하기 전에 요청 객체에 최소 하나의 캡처 버퍼를: The caller must attach at least one capture buffer to the request object before calling {{1}}.
strings.호출자는 마지막 버퍼가 완료되더라도 요청이 자동으로 완성되지 않으므로 명: The caller must explicitly call completeRequest() because the request is not automatically completed even if the last buffer completes.

strings.화질 알고리즘을 담은 별도 모듈(.so)입니다. ISP가 보낸 통계를 보: A separate module (.so) holding the image-quality algorithms. It reads the statistics sent by the ISP and computes the ISP settings for the next frame. It is kept apart from libcamera itself so that vendors can ship it without publishing the source.
strings.활성 경로의 {{1}}는 계산해 둔 가로·세로 셀 수와 셀 크기의 log: The active path of {{1}} writes calculated horizontal and vertical cell counts, log2 cell sizes and grid height per slice to hardware parameters. It uses zero start coordinates for the polynomial method, or half the crop-size minus sensor-size difference otherwise.
